blocks.x: As a travel editor, I’ve snoozed in my fair share of hotel rooms. But I can honestly say that nothing beats sleeping in my own bed. That's because I’ve perfected my sleep setup over the years, curating the ideal mix of pillows, sheets, mattress toppers, and more to help me reach REM. One of the key parts of the equation? My Cozy Earth duvet cover, made with soft-wash cotton that keeps me cool and cozy on even the hottest summer nights. Oh, and the bamboo stretch-knit pajamas from the luxury bedding and loungewear brand don’t hurt either.

If you, too, have been eager to hop on the Cozy Earth train, let this be your sign. I’ve pulled together the best Cozy Earth promo codes, membership perks, and stackable bundle deals below, so you can get the good stuff with a solid discount. Shop away, then prepare to relax on a whole other level. (Looking for more great bedding deals? Check out our coupons for bedding brand Brooklinen.)
Spin to win! Get a welcome gift, such as a $50 discount code, when you sign up for emails

Who doesn’t love a little spin-to-win moment? Head to the Cozy Earth homepage, and you’ll be prompted to click to spin a wheel full of potential discounts—think a $50 discount or a promo code for 10% off your first order. Whatever discount it lands on is yours—you just have to enter your email address (and sign up for Cozy Earth emails) to receive it. Don’t see the wheel? Click the light blue “Spin to Win” button in the bottom left corner.
Cozy Earth last chance deals: 30% off without a coupon code

You can grab 30% off final-sale items by shopping the "Last Chance" section on Cozy Earth's website. Scroll through to find deals on seasonal sheets, sleepwear, and more. I’m personally eyeing this chocolate brown cardigan, down $111 from $158, and these puffy sheep slippers, now $69 after a 30% discount, and these striped bamboo fitted sheets, originally $128 but currently $90. Just make sure you add your favorite items to cart as soon as you spot them, because once they sell out, they’ll be gone for good.
Cozy Earth discounts for healthcare workers, military, and teachers: 20% off

As a thank you for all the work they do, Cozy Earth offers verified healthcare professionals, military members, first responders, teachers, and their family members a 20% discount through the Cozy Cares program. Head to the Cozy Cares section of the Cozy Earth website to verify your eligibility, then submit a claim to receive a unique single-use code to apply at checkout.
Save on bathroom accessories with Cozy Earth bath bundles

Looking to totally revamp your bathroom? Cozy Earth offers a variety of bathroom accessory bundles—featuring a mix of bath sheets, bath towels, hand towels, and washcloths—in coordinating colors. Investing in these bundles is cheaper than if you were to buy the items piecemeal, and everything goes together to build a better bathroom with ease.
Join the Cozy Earth Club to earn even more discounts

If you’re as obsessed with Cozy Earth as I am, you might want to join the Cozy Earth Club. The loyalty program provides members with a number of perks, including free standard shipping, discounts on select products, and points for every dollar spent. Create an account, and you’ll receive 50 points just for joining, which you can then redeem at checkout (100 points is equal to $10 off). There are three tiers of membership, and the more you shop, the bigger your perks—tier three, for example, gets early access to new products, priority customer service, and exclusive access to warehouse sales.
Get free shipping and extra credit on Cozy Earth orders over $100

Surely you don’t need another reason to get your cart total to $100, but it never hurts to have a little more incentive to shop, right? Avoid shipping fees entirely by ensuring your cart subtotal is over $100 after all discounts have been applied, valid for standard shipping within the US. If you’re a Cozy Earth Member, you get to bypass this $100—you get free shipping on all orders, regardless of the final price.
What to do when your Cozy Earth discount code isn’t working

Made your product picks but struggling to check out with your promo code? Troubleshoot by checking to make sure that everything is spelled correctly, there are no extra spaces, and any capitalization is applied. You'll also want to double-check that everything looks good in terms of product exclusions, expiration dates, and minimum spend requirements. It also never hurts to clear your browser’s cache and cookies, or switch devices or browsers. If all else fails, you can always reach out to Cozy Earth's support team.
